# Employee Remote Work Policy

## 1. Eligibility and Equipment
All full-time engineering and product staff are eligible for flexible remote work.
The company provides a standard hardware bundle consisting of:
- One 16-inch laptop with 32 GB RAM.
- Two 27-inch 4K external monitors.
- An ergonomic keyboard and mouse.
A one-time home office reimbursement of $1,000 is available for chairs and desks upon hire.

## 2. Security and Data Protection
Remote employees must connect to corporate infrastructure via the company VPN.
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) via hardware security key (FIDO2) is strictly mandatory.
No company source code or private customer data may be copied to personal storage devices.
Lost or stolen devices must be reported to security@acme.example.com within 2 hours.

## 3. Working Hours and Communication
Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00 in the employee's local time zone.
Asynchronous updates must be posted daily in the team Slack standup channel by 09:30.
Company-wide all-hands meetings take place on the first Thursday of every month at 16:00 UTC.
